items.text: Site & airspace: zone confirmed on Digital Sky airspace map (Green/Yellow/Red); NOTAMs checked
Weather: wind within aircraft limit, no CB/TS in forecast window, visibility OK
Pilot fitness: IMSAFE — Illness, Medication, Stress, Alcohol, Fatigue, Emotion
Frame & arms: no cracks, arms locked, fasteners tight
Propellers: no chips/cracks, correct CW/CCW position, firmly seated
Motors (battery DISCONNECTED): spin each motor by hand — turns freely, no grinding, roughness or play (bearing check)
Battery: no swelling/damage, cells balanced, pack fully charged
Battery connection: hands and body clear of all props; aircraft on flat ground; transmitter ON first, connect battery, step back
GNSS lock (≥10 sats / good HDOP), compass & IMU healthy, home point recorded
Failsafe & RTH altitude set; geofence set; transmitter battery OK
Take-off area clear (5 m radius), people briefed, observer in place
Maintain VLOS at all times
Clear call-outs: take-off, altitude, landing
Monitor battery voltage & flight time; land with ≥25–30% reserve
Stay within authorised altitude and geofence
Watch for people, birds, wires, trees; abort if anyone enters the area
React correctly to warnings (low battery, GPS loss, link loss)
Land, disarm, wait for props to stop completely before approaching
Disconnect battery before touching the aircraft; then transmitter OFF
Touch-check each motor for abnormal heat (bearing / ESC / prop issue)
Inspect props, arms, landing gear for new damage
Battery temperature & voltage; set to storage voltage if not flying again
Logbook: flight time, battery cycle, observations, snags

blocks.title: Simulator
blocks.briefing: Simulator orientation: transmitter modes (Mode 2), stick functions (throttle, yaw, pitch, roll), flight modes (Angle/ATTI/GPS), and a full walkthrough of the pre-, in- and post-flight checklists.

exercises.title: Arm / Disarm
exercises.objective: Correct arming sequence with throttle fully down; disarm only on the ground.
steps: Arm (stick command or switch) — confirm motors idle
Hold 5 s at idle, hands steady
exercises.caution: Never disarm in the air. Never arm with throttle raised.

exercises.title: Take-off & Landing
exercises.objective: Vertical climb to 2 m, 5 s hover, vertical descent, soft touchdown — with NO yaw.
exercises.caution: No yaw during take-off and landing — keep the nose pointing the same way the whole time.

criteria.label: Stable 5 s hover within 1 m box

exercises.title: Hover & Orientation Hold
exercises.objective: Hold position 10 s in each orientation: tail-in, left side-in, right side-in, nose-in.
exercises.caution: In nose-in, roll and pitch feel reversed — make small, slow corrections.

exercises.title: Square — Right & Left
exercises.objective: Fly a 10 m square clockwise (right) then anticlockwise (left) at constant height with crisp corners.
steps: Turn right / translate right, 10 m, stop
exercises.caution: Come to a full stop at every corner before the next leg.

exercises.title: Circle — Clockwise & Anticlockwise
exercises.objective: 10 m-diameter circle in both directions with coordinated yaw, constant height and radius.
steps: Enter circle clockwise, nose following the path
exercises.caution: Keep the radius constant; do not lose altitude in the turn.

exercises.title: Figure-8 (Infinity)
exercises.objective: Two linked circles with a smooth crossover at the centre; both loops equal size.
steps: Take off to 3 m at the centre point
exercises.caution: Plan the crossover in advance and keep speed low.

exercises.title: Spiral Up
exercises.objective: Climbing circle: 3 turns from 2 m to 10 m with constant radius and climb rate.
steps: 3 turns, reaching 10 m on the last
exercises.caution: Watch the altitude ceiling and geofence.

exercises.title: Spiral Down
exercises.objective: Descending circle: 3 turns from 10 m to 2 m with a controlled descent rate.
steps: 3 turns, reaching 2 m on the last
exercises.caution: Avoid fast vertical descent into your own downwash (vortex ring state).

exercises.title: Precision Spot Landing
exercises.objective: Land inside a 1 m circle from 5 m away and 5 m up — three times.
steps: Hover 5 m up, 5 m from pad
exercises.caution: Make only fine corrections in the last metre.

exercises.title: Emergency Handling
exercises.objective: Handle simulated link loss (RTH), GPS loss (ATTI manual hold) and low-battery forced landing.
steps: Instructor triggers link loss → confirm RTH engages
Instructor disables GPS → hold position in ATTI
Low-battery warning → choose safe spot, land
exercises.caution: Take control smoothly — no panic inputs.

criteria.label: Recognised link loss, RTH behaviour correct
Safe forced landing on low battery

blocks.title: On-field
blocks.briefing: Real aircraft at the agricultural farm — the spraying drone with the tank empty / payload removed. Every flight starts with the full pre-flight checklist.

exercises.title: Site Survey & Risk Assessment
exercises.objective: Walk the field boundary, mark obstacles, confirm zone and NOTAMs, check wind.
steps: Mark trees, wires, sheds, people, animals
Confirm zone on Digital Sky airspace map
exercises.caution: Power lines are invisible from the air — find them on the ground first.

exercises.title: Pre-flight on Real Aircraft
exercises.objective: Run the full pre-flight checklist (P1–P11) on the real drone.
steps: Transmitter ON → connect battery with full stand-off
exercises.caution: Keep hands and body clear of all propellers whenever the battery is connected.

exercises.title: Arm, Take-off, Hover, Land
exercises.objective: Real-aircraft take-off to 3 m, stable hover, soft landing — no yaw.
steps: Disarm, wait for props to stop
exercises.caution: Heavier aircraft respond slower than the sim — anticipate.

criteria.label: Waited for props to stop before approach

exercises.title: Square & Circle
exercises.objective: 15 m square and 15 m circle at 5 m AGL, both directions.
exercises.caution: Account for wind drift on each leg.

exercises.title: Figure-8 & Nose-in
exercises.objective: Figure-8 at 5 m AGL and a 10 s nose-in hover.
exercises.caution: Nose-in on a real aircraft: slow inputs only.

exercises.title: Agri A-B Line Spray Pattern (no payload)
exercises.objective: Lawnmower pattern over the plot at 2–3 m AGL, 4–5 m swath spacing, clean headland turns, constant speed.
steps: Set A and B points along the long edge
Fly A→B at constant speed and height
Headland turn, shift one swath (4–5 m)
exercises.caution: Low altitude over crops — watch for poles, wires and people in the field.

exercises.title: Battery Swap & Resume
exercises.objective: Land at the swap point, safe battery change, resume the pattern from the break point.
steps: Disarm, wait for props to stop
exercises.caution: Same stand-off rules apply on every battery swap.

exercises.title: Emergency Drill
exercises.objective: Instructor triggers RTH / link-loss; student takes manual control and lands safely.
exercises.caution: Know your emergency landing spot before every flight.

exercises.title: Post-flight & Logbook
exercises.objective: Post-flight checklist A1–A6 and a complete logbook entry.
exercises.caution: Hot motors after a short flight point to a fault — log it.
